{{Quote|Antares? We need to speak.|Ganner Krieg, upon entering Antares Draco's quarters|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
'''Antares Draco's quarters''' were located on the [[Empire-in-exile]]'s [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and were the personal quarters of [[Antares Draco]], the leader of the [[Imperial Knight]]s. They included a [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]], as well as a table surrounded on three sides by a bench. A [[Window/Legends|window]] next to the table overlooked several tall buildings.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

In [[138 ABY]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] gave Draco three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to devise a plan to rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]], the woman he loved and the Emperor's daughter, from the [[One Sith|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Draco retired to his quarters and consulted the [[Eshkar Niin's holocron|holocron]] of his former Master [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]]. His trusted friend and fellow Imperial Knight [[Ganner Krieg]] visited him at that [[Time/Legends|time]], and as the two sat at the table, Krieg advised Draco to master the anger he felt over Marasiah's [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capture]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Draco then recruited Krieg and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] for an [[Mission to Korriban (Second Imperial Civil War)|infiltration]] of Korriban.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

==Behind the scenes==
Antares Draco's quarters were introduced in the [[Legacy (2006) 49|forty-ninth]] and penultimate issue of [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Legacy 49" /> and released on [[June 30]] [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|subdomain=comicstore|url=Star-Wars-Legacy-2006-2010-49/digital-comic/37539|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006-2010) #49}}</ref>
